summary: Hydrofarm filed a 424B5 amendment (Amendment No. 1, dated November 5, 2026) to its October 27, 2026 prospectus supplement covering a registered direct offering of 1,599,400 common shares to institutional investors, plus a concurrent private placement of 6,971,575 shares, common warrants for up to 9,210,975 shares, and pre-funded warrants for up to 640,000 shares at a 4.99%/9.99% ownership blocker. The amendment is filed solely to correct dilution-section figures (pro forma net tangible book value figures as of June 30, 2026). ThinkEquity is placement agent. This is a routine equity capital raise/shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and warrant overhang for holders.
